title: Finite type is preserved by affine module correspondence
statement: Let $u:U\to X$ be an affine morphism [pqf-def-affine-morphism] of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $\mathcal A=u_*\mathcal O_U$ [def-pc-module-pullback], the sheaf of rings on $X$ with $\mathcal A(W)=\mathcal O_U(u^{-1}W)$. Let $\mathcal M$ be a sheaf of $\mathcal A$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] which is quasi-coherent as an $\mathcal A$-module (every point of $X$ has an open neighbourhood $W$ with an exact sequence $\bigoplus_{j\in J}\mathcal A|_W\to\bigoplus_{i\in I}\mathcal A|_W\to\mathcal M|_W\to0$ of $\mathcal A|_W$-modules), and let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_U$-module [pqf-def-coherent] together with an isomorphism of $\mathcal A$-modules $u_*\mathcal F\cong\mathcal M$, where $u_*\mathcal F$, $W\mapsto\mathcal F(u^{-1}W)$, is an $\mathcal A$-module through the $\mathcal O_U(u^{-1}W)$-module structures (such an $\mathcal F$ exists and is unique up to isomorphism by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-module-correspondence]). Then $\mathcal M$ is of finite type as an $\mathcal A$-module if and only if $\mathcal F$ is of finite type as an $\mathcal O_U$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Here $\mathcal M$ is *of finite type as an $\mathcal A$-module* if it is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation](1) over the ringed space $(X,\mathcal A)$: every point of $X$ has an open neighbourhood $W$ and finitely many sections $s_1,\dots,s_n\in\mathcal M(W)$ such that the $\mathcal A|_W$-linear map $\mathcal A|_W^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal M|_W$, $(f_1,\dots,f_n)\mapsto\sum_if_is_i$, is surjective as a map of sheaves.

proof.text: Transport finite type through the given isomorphism e by transporting local generators with GeneratingSections.ofEpi. A local finite generating cover of a module over any ring sheaf on X refines to affine opens: take the sigma-indexed family of affine subopens of its generating opens, restrict the families with overMap, and transport across overFunctorMap. This is the proved private helper affine_generators_cover.

On an affine V, prove that finite GeneratingSections of (f_*F).over V are equivalent to Module.Finite of F(f^{-1}V). In the forward direction the finite free sheaf has finite sections via freeSectionsLinearEquiv; the evaluation criterion makes its section map surjective, and Module.Finite.of_surjective finishes. In the reverse direction Module.Finite.exists_fin gives a finite spanning family at the terminal object of Over V. Restrict it along the unique maps to that object to define compatible sections. Their evaluation contains every spanning generator in its range by sectionsMap_freeHomEquiv_symm_freeSection, hence is surjective on terminal sections. The evaluation criterion makes it epi. This entire finite-generator equivalence is a proved private helper in the item.

If M is finite type, transport it to N=f_*F and refine its finite generating cover to affine q.X(i). The inverse images form an affine cover of U: lift cover membership at f(y), and use IsAffineOpen.preimage. The finite-generator equivalence makes all inverse-image section modules finite. The covering clause of quasicoherent_finite_type_affine makes F finite type.

If F is finite type, refine its own generating cover to affine opens. A finite global generating family implies finite type on each member by LocalGeneratorsData, so the affine criterion makes sections on those members finite. Its covering clause gives finite sections on every affine open of U. Apply this to the inverse image of every affine open V of X; the finite-generator equivalence supplies finite generators of N.over V. These affine opens cover X and the chosen finite families form LocalGeneratorsData for N. Shrink this data to the module universe to obtain N.IsFiniteType, and transport along e to M.IsFiniteType.
